text:
alex: Quick sync — finalizing prompt inventory + acceptance criteria for the Acme POC. Need owners to confirm: prompt bundles, per-prompt pass/fail metric, baseline model(s), eval timeline, and any security handoff items. Can owners reply w/ status by EOD?

maria: @alex noted. Pricing constraint: customer capped committed spend ~ $8k/month for POC. That limits using very large dedicated variants — prefer q4 and q8 quant configs. Also need a short doc we can drop in the SOW about limits.

devin: tagging in. I propose 3 prompt families for the POC: support-summary, intent-classifier, order-extraction. Baselines: open-llama-13b (q8_0), and a quantized Llama 2 13B path for latency comparison.

devin: Eval plan (short): run 500-shot holdout per family, metrics: ROUGE-L for summaries, F1/EM for extraction, macro-F1 for classifier. Define pass thresholds in acceptance matrix. I can spin up runs next week.

devin: Example acceptance matrix (first pass):
```
bundle: support-summary
metric: ROUGE-L >= 0.55
latency_p95: <= 400ms
cost_per_1k_tokens: <= $0.90
pass_condition: >= 3/5 prompt templates meet metric
```

sarah: Security heads-up: we need to capture exact data types in prompts (no full PII in test set), confirm encryption-at-rest and KMS usage for any uploaded assets, and get a signed NDA before sharing logs. I also need answers to the standard security questionnaire by Thu.

ryan: Customer success: customer success criteria = 30% reduction in average handle time (AHT) on support flows and >=85% accuracy on entity extraction. Also they'd like a 2-week evaluation window + 1-week buffer for tuning.

maria: On timeline & resourcing: Sales will own SOW language for limits. @devin can you mark which evals need Dedicated (GPU) vs Hosted? We should avoid high-cost long runs.

devin: Hosted is fine for classifier and extraction (batch runs), summary p95 latency target will likely need small dedicated instance for stable p95. I'll flag exact instance types in the eval ticket.

presales-bot: checklist update: POC plan created; prompt inventory partial; security intake required; SOW spend cap noted. Link: https://redwood.internal/presales/1798765432 (internal). :white_check_mark:

alex: For prompt inventory, owners please paste canonical prompt templates (including system instructions + examples) into the shared doc. Use this format:
- prompt_id
- family
- template (with placeholders)
- sample_inputs (3)
- desired_output_format

alex: I'll collate acceptance matrix and create a GH issue with prompt set + eval scripts tomorrow morning. If we hit blockers on security questionnaire, @sarah please surface which Qs are blocking external share.

sarah: Will do. Also: request audit log export permission from their infra contact — need that before we can ingest logs for eval.

maria: I'll get SOW appendix drafted today and share for review.

ryan: I'll prep customer success baseline metrics and share current AHT + sample tickets for the 500-shot eval.

alex: Awesome — thanks. If everyone can drop their prompt templates + one placeholder example in the doc by EOD, I'll finalize and send the POC plan to the customer. :eyes:
